Configuring the agent runtime

The system prompt parameter is read from `config.systemPrompt` at startup;
when unset, the runtime falls back to the built-in default. Instructions for
overriding it live in docs/configuration.md — the previous instructions
section there was rewritten in v2, so prior instructions from the v1 guide
no longer apply to new deployments (they were removed, not deprecated).

```ts
// The tool-call loop: each tool result is appended to the transcript.
// A handler acting as a fallback receives unmatched names.
registry.register("fetch", async (args) => {
  // Executing this handler requires a resolved URL; the fetch tool's
  // redirect cap is enforced upstream by the caller.
  return fetchBounded(args.url);
});
```

Roles and permissions: a role is assigned at session start and the role
field is immutable afterwards; pretending otherwise in the UI would desync
the server state. When pasting configuration into the terminal, quote the
JSON so the shell leaves it intact. Commands are run by the supervisor with
the following environment: PATH, HOME, and the scoped state directory.

Ignoring transient errors from any of the above providers is safe; all
instructions the validator emits are advisory. You can now review the
transcript with the viewer tool enabled in settings.
